name: Siegfried Mureşan, Carla Tavares - Après le § 39 - Am 72
title: INTERIM REPORT on the proposal for a Council regulation laying down the Multiannual Financial Framework for the years 2028 to 2034
part_text: 17aa. Stresses that the EU already provides substantial and indispensable support to cities and urban areas through the cohesion policy, further reinforced by several sectoral instruments; firmly insists, therefore, that the current ‘urban earmarking’ of at least 8 % of investments per Member State must be unequivocally maintained under the NRPPs;
